card.name: Spaces and commas before numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas or first digits just before a number, such as a count or a day number in a dose schedule. Also a few odd spots in the middle of names.

modes.label: Gap before a count
modes.description: The space or digit right before a number of items, like 30 more dams.

modes.label: Comma in day lists
modes.description: A comma between day numbers in an injection schedule, just before the next number.
modes.example: as one 5 mL injection on Days 1, 15<<,>> 29, and once monthly thereafter

modes.label: Space before time span
modes.description: A space before a number of days or months in a dosing schedule.
